description: Tesla, Inc. is focused on bringing artificial intelligence into the real world through products and services like Full Self-Driving (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots including Optimus, and it intends to leverage its current operations, in which it designs, develops, manufactures, sells and leases high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to its customers, to achieve that objective. It generally sells its products directly to customers, and continues to grow its global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of its products, emphasizing performance, attractive styling and the safety of its users and workforce in the design and manufacture of its products and continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety, and it strives to lower the cost of ownership for its customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs. Its performance and safety systems and battery packs utilize sophisticated control software, and it develops almost all of this software, including most user interfaces, internally and updates its vehicles' software regularly through over-the-air updates.
